fields.description: The app's module name, such as intrakore_crm.
fields.label: App

fields.description: The order in the devops manifest. Of two apps that can install at the same time, the lower one installs first.
fields.label: Install Order

fields.description: The branch the commit is on. Blank takes the default branch.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: The full commit the image installs.
fields.label: Commit

fields.description: The app's __version__ at the commit. An Atlas tag of the image carries it.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: The apps that install before this one, one per line: the required_apps of its hooks.py at the commit.
fields.label: Requires

fields.description: The https:// clone URL. Blank takes the repository base and the app name.
fields.label: Repository
